app.name: LittleFounders
app.tagline: Learn, play, and build your future

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or something in the app pointed to the wrong place. Nothing you did caused this.

routeError.title: This screen ran into a problem
routeError.body: Something went wrong loading this part of the app. It is not something you did.
routeError.staleBody: The app updated while this tab was open, so this screen could not finish loading. A refresh picks up the new one.

family.title: Your family
family.subtitle: Watch each founder’s territory grow.
family.emptyBody: When you link and verify a kid’s account, their learning territory appears here.
family.territorySubtitle: Everything the course teaches, and how much is already theirs.

badge.error: Could not create the badge right now
badge.disclosure: This creates a link anyone with it can open. It expires in 30 days, you can revoke it from your Family panel, and it helps LittleFounders grow.

insightsConsent.label: Share usage insights
insightsConsent.hint: Help improve lessons with anonymous-style usage signals. You can turn this off anytime.

addKid.title: Add a child
addKid.body: You create the account, so your child never needs an email address. You can see everything they do from here.
addKid.displayNameHint: Only the first name. It is what the mentors will call them.
addKid.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and _ . Three to twenty characters.
addKid.passphraseHint: At least 8 characters. You choose it and you can change it later.
addKid.birthDateHint: Optional. It only picks the right age band for the lessons.
addKid.doneBody: {{name}} can sign in with the username {{username}} and the passphrase you chose.
addKid.privacy: We ask for as little as possible: a first name, a username and a passphrase. No email, no surname, no address.

manageKid.rotateDone: Done. Tell them the new passphrase.
manageKid.removeWarning: This deletes {{name}} and everything they have done: their progress, their streak and their conversations. It cannot be undone.
manageKid.removeBlocked: This account is missing some information, so it cannot be removed here. Contact support.
manageKid.usernameFixed: The username cannot be changed. It is how they sign in.

cookies.title: Your privacy matters
cookies.body: We use necessary technologies to keep LittleFounders working. With your permission, optional measurement helps us understand which content and campaigns improve the experience. You can accept, reject or configure these choices.
cookies.preferencesIntro: Your choices apply to this browser and can be changed at any time. Rejecting optional technologies does not affect access to LittleFounders.
cookies.necessaryDescription: Used for security, navigation, language and remembering your privacy choice. These cannot be switched off because the site would not work reliably without them.
cookies.attributionDescription: An anonymous identifier on our domain helps us understand which public pages and campaigns lead people to LittleFounders. It is not sold or shared with ad networks.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Privacy-focused measurement and, when enabled, Google Analytics help us evaluate public pages and improve the product. These tools are not used to personalize advertising inside the learning experience.
cookies.privacyNote: For the full details, including retention, providers and how to withdraw consent, read our

parent.emptyBody: Create your first task and it will show up here once it's ready for your approval.
parent.catalogSubtitle: Real rewards your kids can ask for with LF Coins.
parent.catalogEmptyBody: Add something your kids can ask for: extra screen time, choosing dinner, a later bedtime.
parent.redemptionInsufficientBalance: They no longer have enough LF Coins for this
parent.evidenceAlt: Photo Sofia attached as proof for "{{title}}"
parent.emptyNoKidsBody: Once you've linked and verified a child, their first task can go here.
parent.cancelReasonPlaceholder: e.g. "The bed still needs the pillows"
parent.cancelConfirmQuestionWithEvidence: Cancel this task? Their photo will be removed too.
parent.requiresEvidenceToggle: Require a photo before I can approve this
parent.denyConfirmQuestion: Answer not yet to this request?
parent.bankingLink: View wallet details in Digital Banking

kid.subtitle: Do your chores, earn LF Coins, and decide what to do with them.
kid.emptyBody: Ask your grown-up to add your first task.
kid.allocateGoal: Send some Save coins to a goal
kid.goalEmptyBody: Set a goal and watch it fill up every time you save.
kid.catalogEmpty: Your grown-up hasn't added any rewards yet.
kid.evidenceAlt: Photo you added as proof for "{{title}}"
kid.evidenceRetry: Photo didn't load — tap to retry
kid.requiresEvidenceHint: Add a photo to finish this one
kid.activityEmpty: Nothing yet — complete a task to see it here.

kid.subtitle: Practice with your LF Coins: a practice card, pockets and goals.
kid.emptyBody: Ask a parent to open your Digital Banking account — your Save, Spend and Share balance is already waiting for it.
kid.freezeHint: Pauses reward requests, splits and gifts
kid.frozenHold: Your coins wait here while the card is frozen. You can split them after it is unfrozen.

parent.subtitle: Open accounts, automate allowance, and set up a savings bonus.
parent.openBody: Give them a named practice card. Their Save, Spend and Share coins carry right over.
parent.spendLimitHint: Checked each time your child asks for a reward.
parent.bonusHint: A bonus your family adds to their Save jar every week — not a bank interest rate.
